_doc: What lies round the foot of things on the farm, so each stands planted in a place and not set down on bare grass (scripts/world3d/dressing.gd). By the kind of object: tufts of taller grass, wildflowers and stones are scattered in a band `band` tiles wide just outside the object's footprint edge (different round each object: its own seed). Counts scale with the footprint's perimeter (per tile of edge). Kinds not listed get nothing.
